specimens.name: 24 · Monthly balances
specimens.note: Monthly recording is available from the last calendar day of the month. Current-month early payment is recorded on an individual expense share instead. The second $60 suggestion to Alex remains in the scrollable list.

specimens.name: 25 · Add shared expense
specimens.note: Only the payer can attach one of their private accounts. Members see the receipt, payer, total, shares, and history; the payer’s account details stay private.

specimens.name: 28 · Shared expense details

specimens.name: 29 · Record paid share
